issues.text: Team photo (182:2559 / 182:2560) is still not rendered. The frame itself is pixel-exact (measured x=618-1391 = 774px, y=332-852 = 520px, radius 4px, #ECECEC hairline, 'OUR TEAM' chip inset 24px, no scrim - all correct), but its whole interior is the flat `photo-placeholder` gradient (sampled #F6F6F7 -> #E5E4E6). That is a 774x520 empty grey block - roughly a third of the section's area - where Figma shows the team group photo. Export about-team.jpg (1114 x 740) from node 182:2560 into public/ and render it with object-fit: cover, object-position approx -170px -31px; the TODO comment in src/app/sections/about/about.tsx already records the exact values.

LinkedIn glyph is set to `h-4 w-[17px]` on the team cards; Figma draws 16 x 16 (182:2097 / 2099 / 2101). The extra pixel of width stretches the mark very slightly. Imperceptible, but it is a one-character fix.
The trades-list overrun from iteration 1 is fixed: the second bullet column now starts at x=963 with its label at x=977, against Figma's 960 / 976 (247:723 / 247:677). The 659px measure is holding.

Section geometry is exact against the Figma frame: 1440 x 948 render, 48px gutter, left block columns 1-4, right block starting at x=618 (138px empty column-5 trough), row 2 at y=332, 96px bottom padding. Cards measured at y=332-478, 490-636, 648-794, i.e. 146px tall with a 12px stack gap - identical to nodes 182:1880 / 1889 / 1899.

Type and colour tokens verified: h2 at 48px / 48px line-height, -1.92px tracking, weight 450, colour rgb(41,29,29) = ink #291D1D; eyebrow Overpass Mono Bold 12px / 12px, +0.12px, uppercase at 60%; card border #ECECEC and bullet box rgba(25,25,25,0.08) per spec section 8. Card hover is border-hairline -> border-rule at 160ms on --ease-fluid, matching the Motion table.

Restraint holds: the FPO // Image Placeholder badge (182:2564) is correctly not shipped, the 'Our Team' chip correctly has no scrim gradient, and no background ruler lines were invented (spec section 7 states the page has none). The red '2 Issues' pill bottom-left is the Next.js dev overlay, not build output.

Exposure and Matter are licensed faces that are not present in the project, so the heading falls back to Newsreader and body text to Inter. This is a project-wide font-loading matter set up in the shared font config, not something this section's file controls - noted, not scored against the section.
Team photo still absent - the same flat grey placeholder, here at 702 x 470, and it is the single largest block on the screen. See the desktop note on exporting about-team.jpg.

Heading uses the global `text-display-md` clamp (2rem -> 3rem on 3.3333vw), so at 768px it renders at 32px. The spec's responsive table calls for clamp(36px, 3.8vw, 48px) in the 1024-1279 band, which the display-md token undershoots by roughly 5px at 1024. No tablet mock exists to contradict either value; the build reads fine as drawn.

The ~152px void under the heading reported in iteration 1 is gone: the intro bottom padding and trades top padding are now scoped to lg:, leaving the 64px row gap alone. Measured heading baseline to trades lead is now a clean single gap.

No Figma tablet reference. The adaptation is sound: single-column stack in intro / trades / cards / photo order, 32px gutter, trades list holds its 2 columns, cards go full width, photo holds the 774/520 aspect. No overflow, clipping or overlap.
Team photo still absent - flat grey placeholder at 342 x 230. See the desktop note on exporting about-team.jpg.
The stacked-padding void from iteration 1 is resolved here too; the heading now sits a single 48px row gap above the trades lead.

No Figma mobile reference. The adaptation is sound: 24px gutter, trades list drops to 1 column at 12px row gap with the Figma reading order preserved (Tesla, Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Canadian Special Forces, Mercedes-AMG Formula 1 Team, Microsoft, Damen Shipyards Group, Bay Ship and Yacht), cards stretch full width, heading wraps to 2 lines. No horizontal overflow, nothing clipped.

summary: Iteration 2 closed both layout defects from iteration 1 - the trades list now sits on its 659px Figma measure and the desktop-only paddings no longer stack into a void on the smaller breakpoints - leaving a section whose geometry, card metrics and type/colour tokens are pixel-exact against the Figma frame, with the still-unfilled 774x520 team photo as the one substantive gap.
